SEC-01.gap: Holders of identity.users.update can change password/email/status of users with protected roles (OrganizationAdmin); holders of identity.roles.update can add permissions they do not hold to their own role; identity.roles.assign is not enforced on user create/update (SECURITY_PROGRAM F-C1, F-C2; product decision pending).

SEC-03.gap: Access token TTL is 15 days while ADR-0003 states 15 minutes and sessions have no absolute/idle expiry; login revokes all other sessions although ADR-0003 lists multi-device support; login/signup responses enumerate accounts (SECURITY_PROGRAM R-2, F-C6).

SEC-04.gap: No repository secret scanning step in Core CI; rotation/revocation path for JWT signing key not evidenced; JWT_SECRET_KEY and CORE_IDENTITY_ACTION_TOKEN_SECRET_KEY still have public dev-insecure defaults with no startup guard; HS256 signing key is shared with FAIR CRM and Fair Stand (SECURITY_PROGRAM F-C5/F-C8).

SEC-05.gap: Application/migration/backup database role scopes and network exposure are deployment configuration; no repository test or masked live evidence yet.

SEC-06.gap: No injection negative tests. Source check 2026-10-25 found no raw text()/f-string SQL or shell calls in backend/app; dynamic sort/filter inputs not yet inventoried.

SEC-07.reason: Core exposes no file upload or import endpoint: no UploadFile/File parameters in backend/app (source check 2026-10-25). Reopen when an upload surface is added.

SEC-09.gap: Core CI has no dependency audit step (pip-audit or equivalent); requirements.txt risk is not tracked automatically.

SEC-10.gap: Core workflow has no explicit permissions block; ruff step silently skips when ruff is not installed; required checks and branch protection not verified.

SEC-11.gap: SMTP adapter defaults to STARTTLS but has no test; FAIR_CRM_BASE_URL lifecycle call does not enforce https; live TLS not verified.

SEC-12.gap: Core database backup and isolated restore evidence missing; backup scripts live in fair-crm operations (E-007).

SEC-14.reason: Core API returns JSON only (no HTMLResponse) and the SMTP adapter sends plain-text bodies via EmailMessage.set_content; no user content is rendered as HTML.

SEC-15.reason: Core sets and reads no cookies: no set_cookie or Cookie parameters in backend/app (source check 2026-10-25). Reopen if a cookie session is added.

SEC-16.gap: No login/reset/signup rate limit or lockout in Core code (source check 2026-10-25); whether an upstream proxy limits these routes is unverified.

SEC-17.gap: Core sets no security headers itself; proxy-level HSTS/nosniff/frame-ancestors not verified.

SEC-18.reason: No CORSMiddleware is installed, so browsers receive no cross-origin allowance from Core; reopen if CORS is configured in the app or proxy.

SEC-19.reason: Authentication is bearer-token only with no cookie session, so a cross-site request cannot carry Core credentials automatically.

SEC-21.reason: Outbound targets come only from deployment settings (FAIR_CRM_BASE_URL, CORE_SMTP_HOST); no request-supplied URL or host is fetched by the server.
